description: Hari Raya Idul Fitri (1 Syawal) day 1 in Indonesia, as set by the government. Used by the monthly landfill-intake forecaster for the Ramadan and Lebaran-exodus (mudik) calendar features. These dates are published in advance (SKB cuti bersama), so they are known at forecast time.
source: SKB Menteri Agama, Menteri Ketenagakerjaan dan Menteri PANRB tentang hari libur nasional dan cuti bersama (one SKB per year); the final 1 Syawal date is set by the Minister of Religious Affairs after sidang isbat.
verification_note: verified=true only where the date was cross-checked against a source stored in this repository. Unverified dates are public record but must be checked against the official SKB/Kemenag decision before they are relied on.
